name: planner
description: Alarms, timers, reminders, todos, notes and a calendar, kept on the box so something rings when the Mac is shut.

tips.text: Type `vyre remind "call juno" at 6` and it rings on every device with push on, and as a banner in the Deck.
`vyre timer 25m bread` starts a labelled timer that rings on every device, even when your Mac is shut.
Answer a ring once, anywhere. Done or Snooze in the Deck closes the notification on your other devices.
End a todo with `!high`, `!!` or `!low` to set its priority: `vyre todo add send the Northwind Bakery invoice by friday !high`.
`vyre snooze <id> 15` rings again in 15 minutes. Leave out the number and it waits 9.
An alarm nobody answers rings again every 5 minutes, 3 more times. Change both with `vyre call planner.settings`.
Want "Call kit" on the lock screen, not just "Reminder"? Run `vyre call push.settings '{"planner_label": true}'`.
Ask juno to remind you of something and juno adds the reminder itself, with no prompt and no Touch ID.
Run `vyre agenda` for today's alarms, reminders and calendar events, then the todos due, overdue ones included.
